scene: The pried hatch spills tokens, revealing three hidden exits across the station.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the mossy station platform along the bottom. On the far left, a rusty open freight lift waits. To its right, the boy with curly hair and round glasses holds spilled brass tokens by the vending machine. Centre sits a lit night tram on flooded tracks. Right, a glowing glass service elevator stands ready.
shown: a heavy iron freight lift with open accordion gates on the far left
a glowing yellow night tram parked on submerged tracks in the centre
a sleek glass service elevator shaft glowing with neon buttons on the right
